english:
The first psalm of the morning and evening is this.
But at the evening dismissal: "Lift up your gates, O princes" [Psalm 23:7 / 24:7].
Gospel according to Luke 18:15 "They brought to Him..." to verse 34 "...the things that were spoken."
Midday [Chashu] Hymn, Tone 8 [dk]: "Who by mercy" (Որ ողորմութեամբ).
Psalm 121 [122] "I was glad," "Unto thee, O Lord" [Psalm 122 / 123], "If it had not been the Lord" [Psalm 123 / 124].
Acts 21:37 "As he was led..." to verse 22:29 "...because he had bound him."
Psalm 46 [47]: "God has gone up."
Catholic Epistle, 1 John 4:7 "Beloved, let us love..." to verse 21 "...and his brother also."
Alleluia, Psalm 23 [24]: "Lift up..."
Gospel according to John 11:47 "Then gathered..." to verse 54 "...with His disciples."
In the Evening, first Psalm 46 [47]: "God has gone up."
Gospel according to Matthew 19:16 "And behold, one came..." to verse 20:16 "...are chosen."
Messedi: "The Lord is powerful," "The earth is the Lord's."
Hambartsi [Hymn at Evening], Tone 7 [dz]: "You who were planted together" (Որք տնկակիցք), and "Our Lord Christ ascended."
Dismissal Psalm 23 [24]: "Lift up [your gates], O princes."
Gospel according to Mark 10:28 "Then Peter began to say..." to verse 32 "...and they were afraid."

Monday. Tone 2 [ak]: "Sing to the Lord."
Hargh [Hymn of the Fathers], Tone 7 [dz]: "Glorifying" (Փառաւորելով).
Morning Gospel according to Luke 18:35 "And it came to pass, as He was come nigh..." to verse 19:28 "...going up to Jerusalem."
Midday Hymn, Tone 8 [dk]: "Powers" (Իշխանութիւնք).
Psalm 124 [125] "They that trust," "When the Lord turned" [Psalm 125 / 126], "If it had not been the Lord" [Psalm 123 / 124].
Acts 22:30 "On the morrow..." to verse 23:11 "...testified in Rome."
Psalm 46 [47]: "God has gone up."
Catholic Epistle, 1 John 5:1 "Whosoever believeth..." to verse 12 "...and hath not life."
Alleluia, Psalm 23 [24]: "Lift up..."
Gospel according to John 11:55 "And the Passover was nigh..." to verse 12:11 "...and believed in Jesus."
In the Evening, first Gospel according to Matthew 20:17 "And as Jesus was going up..." to verse 28 "...instead of many."
Messedi: "Blessed is He who comes," "The Lord is our God."
Hambartsi [Hymn at Evening], Tone 6 [gz]: "Being King" (Թագաւոր գոլով).
Dismissal Gospel according to Mark 10:33 "And taking..." to verse 45 "...instead of many."

Fifth Sunday, which is called Second Palm Sunday.
Processional Hymn, Tone 5 [gz]: "Our Lord ascended into heaven."
Morning Hymn, Tone 8 [dk]: "Wondrous" (Մեծահրաշ).
Hargh [Hymn of the Fathers], Tone 8 [dk]: "Today Creator," with its canon.
But after the "Holy God" [Trisagion], they shall go out in procession with the Cross and Gospel, singing the Hymn, Tone 7 [dz]: "Being King of Your glory" (Թագաւոր գոլով քո).
Psalm 97 [98]: "Let the mountains rejoice." Verse: "Sing unto the Lord."
Scripture, Song of Songs 6:9 "Who is she that looketh forth..." to verse 8:13 "...cause me to hear."
Prophet Isaiah 63:1 "Who is this that cometh..." to verse 6 "...them down to the earth."
Epistle to the Hebrews 9:24 "For Christ is not entered into the holy places made with hands..." to verse 28 "...unto salvation."
Alleluia: "Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord, blessed are You who are to come."
Gospel according to Luke 19:29 "And it came to pass, when..." to verse 48 "...to hear Him."
And they shall perform the Blessing of the Four Corners of the Earth [Andastan].
Proclamation: "By this Holy Cross."
Prayer: "Protect [us]."
And then [the hymn]: "Newly created" (Նորաստեղծեալ).
Proclamation: "Let us ask," "Save [us]."
Prayer: "Your all-powerful [dominion]."
Midday Introits [Zhamamut]: "The heavenly hosts were amazed."
Hymn, Tone 7 [dz]: "Your coming, O Christ."
Psalm 127 [128] "Blessed is everyone," "Many a time" [Psalm 128 / 129], "Out of the depths have I cried" [Psalm 129 / 130].
Acts 23:12 "And when it was day..." to verse 25 "...to keep him."
Psalm 46 [47]: "God has gone up."
Catholic Epistle, 1 John 5:13 "These things have I written unto you..." to verse 21 "...from idols."
Alleluia, Psalm 24 [25]: "Lift up..."
Gospel according to John 12:12 "On the next day..." to verse 23 "...the Son of Man."
In the Evening, first Gospel according to Matthew 20:29 "And as they departed..." to verse 21:17 "...and lodged there."
And they shall go out in procession with the Cross and Gospel, singing the Hymn, Tone 3 [bz]: "We have taken refuge in Your Cross" (Ապաւինեցաք ի խաչ քո).
After the Psalm 4: "There has been signed upon us..." Verse: "When I called."
Gospel according to Mark 15:20 "And they led Him out..." to verse 37 "...and yielded up the ghost."
And they shall perform the Blessing of the Four Corners of the Earth [Andastan].
Proclamation: "By this Holy Cross."
Prayer: "Protect [us]."
And then "Bow down Your ear" [Psalm 85 / 86] and "Deliver me" [Psalm 139 / 140].
Messedi: "The Lord reigns, let Him rejoice," "They appeared."
Hambartsi [Hymn at Evening].
